ModMetaData.name: ReSplice: Charmweavers
ModMetaData.author: Helixien
ModMetaData.description:
ReSplice is the banner under which I will release any xenotype I feel like making. As with ReGrowth, I aim for my additions to fit vanilla in both art style and lore. Everything added was made to fit or mirror vanilla. From a simple UI texture to a new, more complex system, my main objective is to keep everything efficient and consistent with vanilla.
Inspired by the well-known succubus and incubus, charmweavers are a new xenotype powered by archites that you can encounter and add to your colonies. They are rare, like sanguophages, and quite unique, offering some interesting upsides and downsides.
Charmweavers are a relatively simple xenotype. They should work fine in whatever load order you have and be a nice addition, if not for the xenotype itself, then for the genes they add.
ReSplice is designed to be as lightweight as possible, adding the minimum amount of new code required for its additions to work.
